name: PII Guard
description: Blocks known personal-data formats (emails, phone and card numbers, IBANs, US SSNs, Matrix ids, credentials) in text an agent sends to another agent. Deterministic; blocks text it can't read.

allowTargets.description: Agent ids whose incoming text is not checked, such as agents with no web or channel access. Empty (the default) means text to every agent is checked.

kinds.description: The kinds to block. Default: every kind except ip-address.
